history.summary: 1BR at Promenade Peak, Allgreen's 99LH 596-unit new launch on Zion Road (D03 River Valley), TOP ~2029, $1.43M at $2,713 PSF — below the $3,090 project median, and 410m to Great World TEL. Prime location and strong launch demand (53.7% sold at launch), but it's an unbuilt new launch with developer-inflated pricing and a niche 1BR resale profile.
history.rating_rationale: Web check: launched Aug 2025 at avg $2,894–$3,343 PSF, world's tallest PPVC tower, 410m to Great World/Havelock MRT, TOP ~2029. This $2,713 PSF 1BR is below project median (likely a lower-floor stack), in genuinely prime D03 with GSW/TEL tailwinds. But the URA appreciation is null (no resale history — new launch), has_new_launch_bias is on, you carry ~3yrs of construction/SSD-clock risk, and 1BR has the narrowest resale/tenant pool. Location is excellent; the entry premium and unproven price trend make it a hold-with-caution, not a clear buy.
red_flags: New launch, TOP ~2029 — no resale price history, developer-inflated pricing
1BR niche unit — narrowest resale and tenant pool
99LH on prime ground where freehold comps exist
catalysts: 410m to Great World MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line)
Prime River Valley address, Allgreen developer; strong 53.7% launch take-up
